_todo: OQ-COACH (M2 H1b commit 5, scripts/ui/hud_coach.gd): the first-play coach. A short skippable sequence of one-line hints on the first real match, one at a time, each pointing at its control with a gold ring and a pointer. Every number and every text here is a placeholder. It never blocks input and never pauses the match: the hints and pointers ignore touches; the only touch target is Skip.
_enabled_note: Data switch: false = the coach never shows (Settings still offers the replay row).
_require_touch_hud_note: Every hint points at a touch control, so the coach shows only while the touch HUD is shown (touch_hud.should_show(): a touch device or force_touch_hud). Mouse / keyboard / gamepad: no coach, coach_done is left as it is. Nothing here asks for an OS.

skip._note: The coach's ONLY touch target, under the alive / zone chip at the left edge (the top of the left half, outside the look area), shown only while a hint shows (and in the short gap between two). It takes a little of the stick start zone's top-left corner only while the coach runs. width_units is the plate width (never under min_dp; kept narrow so it stays left of the Sprint lock target on 1512x648 at 420 dpi); gap_units is the gap under the chip. Two lines: the word, and the step counter.

advance._note: What counts as doing the thing (read-only, never consumes input): moved = the pawn walked move_m on the ground; turned = the view yaw turned look_deg in total; aimed = pawn.aiming; fired = the pawn's fired signal; in_cover = pawn.in_cover(); interacted = an interact press (touch provider's action_triggered, or the interact action); map_opened = the minimap expanded.

steps.text: Drag on the right side to look around
Tap Aim to raise your sight

text_by_mode.simple: Sight up on an enemy and you fire by yourself

steps.text: Near a wall, tap Cover to take cover
Tap the prompt to pick it up
steps._note: Applies only while the Interact button offers a pickup or a chest (host or offline; a LAN client never shows Interact, so the step is skipped there). Not applicable when reached: waits up to wait_s (nothing shown, Skip hidden), then is skipped.
